decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am to 5.00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9.00am  to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to Marjory Kinnon School shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 8 - INFORMATIVE

The development hereby approved does not include the new basketball pitch shown on the submitted drawings.
description: Erection of a single-storey extension to the existing building to provide classroom & community/resource room centre and alterations to three separate elevations.
